map.tmux 会话默认是独立的：每个会话有自己的窗口与进程，除非主动共享（如用 tm: tmux sessions are independent by default: each session has its own windows and processes, and they do not interfere unless you explicitly share them (e.g., using tmux -S to specify the same socket with the same user). That is by design — for collaboration you must explicitly share the socket and set permissions, rather than expecting automatic sync.

map.tmux -- 匿名会话\ntmux new -s work -- 名为 w:
tmux  -- anonymous session
tmux new -s work  -- named work
tmux new -s work -d  -- detached
map.tmux kill-session -t old\ntmux kill-sess:
tmux kill-session -t old
tmux kill-session -a  -- kill all except the current one
map.tmux kill-server -- 关闭所有 tmux: tmux kill-server  -- kill all tmux sessions

# Press C-b first, then the following key
# e.g. C-b c creates a window
map.C-b d -- 会话在后台继续: C-b d  -- the session keeps running in the background
map.C-b s -- 列表选择: C-b s  -- pick from a list
map.C-b n 下个\nC-b p 上个:
C-b n  next
C-b p  previous
map.C-b q -- 显示编号\nC-b q 2 -- 跳到 2 号:
C-b q  -- show numbers
C-b q 2  -- jump to number 2
map.C-b x -- 关闭当前: C-b x  -- close the current pane
map.C-b z -- 当前窗格全屏/还原: C-b z  -- toggle full screen for the current pane
map.C-b { -- 与上一个交换: C-b {  -- swap with the previous one
map.C-b C-→ -- 向右扩大: C-b C-→  -- grow to the right
map.C-b [ -- 进入复制模式\n 空格 开始选择\n Enter 复制\:
C-b [  -- enter copy mode
  Space starts selection
  Enter copies
  q exits
map.C-b = -- 列出缓冲区选择粘贴: C-b =  -- list buffers and pick one to paste
map.C-b :set mouse on -- 开启鼠标\nC-b :source:
C-b :set mouse on  -- enable the mouse
C-b :source ~/.tmux.conf  -- reload the config
map.C-b t -- 大时钟\n任意键退出:
C-b t  -- big clock
any key exits
